opennyai_summary.20_June_2023__facts:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973, for grant of bail during trial.
The applicant is facing trial in connection with Crime No.634/2022 registered at Police Station- Betma, District- Indore concerning offence under Sections 376(2)(h), 376(2)(i), 376(2)(n)/34, 109 and 506 of IPC, 1860 and Section 6, 12 and 17 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
Applicant is in jail since 12.01.2023.
2. Allegation against the applicant, who happens to be the brother-in-law of the prosecutrix is that he used to harass and abuse the victim sexually, during her stay in their house.
opennyai_summary.20_June_2023__arguments:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime due to previous petty dispute.
There is a delay of 8 months and 15 days in lodging the FIR for and no proper explanation has been offered in this regard.
opennyai_summary.20_June_2023__decision:
The applicant is in custody since 13.01.2023 (more than 5 months) and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, prayer was made for grant of bail to the applicant.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.

The appellant has been convicted under Section 450 of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years with fine of Rs.2,000/- and under Section 376 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for ten years with fine of Rs. 2000/- with default stipulation.
